card.fires_on: No single word or setting fits. It fires on mixed small words and punctuation (a comma, from, or, in, contain) and on partial names, in historical biography text and drug-label text.

modes.label: Comma after a person's name
modes.description: A comma right after a full personal name in a biography.

modes.label: Linking word in running prose
modes.description: A small linking word such as from, in or or in the middle of a sentence.
modes.example: contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to nateglinide<< or>> its inactive ingredients.
